notes.title: May 2025 Status Report
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone,[/b]

sadly we don't have anything new to talk about regarding the development progress of the multiplayer playtest and early access release at the moment. Everything from the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2621270/announcements/detail/4513262258492539089]previous status report[/url] still applies. 

But nonetheless, we can talk about some features that we haven't revealed until now!

[i]Keep in mind that those features are still in development and may change before the next release.[/i]

[h2]Expedition Loadout Customization[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717128/3ed14c359b8d30bb0416e352685c78daaa0f7aec.png[/img]
Dusky Depths will feature customizable starting loadouts for expeditions. To customize your loadout, you will have to analyze items first by either recycling or upgrading them on an expedition. Afterwards, that item will be available for loadout customization on your next expedition! 

However, those items aren't free. If you don't have enough material to afford your custom loadout, you will spawn with a penalty...

[h2]Enemy Elites[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717128/d89290ae3497a596945433d6672e0ebcb4045941.png[/img]
Enemies may rarely appear as elite variants, with various special skills! In the above screenshot, you can see a drone with the [b]Forfending[/b] trait in the rear, which grants all nearby drones a buff that increases their defense! Destroy the elite first, then deal with the rest!

[h2]Expedition Directives[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717128/f815064f5f6862c506568333af26ed2506540f01.png[/img]
Expeditions have become stale? Unlock and activate Expedition Directives to change the framework of your expeditions.

[h2]Engine Dodge Types[/h2]
[previewyoutube=qgQUwa5-5yo;full][/previewyoutube]
Depending on your engine item, you will gain access to different dodge technologies.
[list]
[*][b]Turbo[/b] - Significantly improves your ship's maneuverability stats.
[*][b]Boost[/b] - Applies an impulse to your ship, pushing it towards your desired direction. This was the only dodge tech available in the demo.
[*][b]Dash[/b] - Moves your ship at a constant high speed towards your desired direction and resets your momentum afterwards.
[/list]

 [hr][/hr] 

Once again, we hope that we will be able to talk about the upcoming multiplayer playtest soon!
In the meantime, if you have any questions or feedback, join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/SsbjpHZ]Discord[/url] or leave a comment below this article!

notes.title: Demo Update Feb 02 (0.3.44)
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1]

Based on your feedback and bug reports, we have prepared a new patch for the demo.

[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added/extended various options to customize the HUD[i] (via User Interface Settings)[/i]
[*] Added minimum and maximum reticle clamp options to the gamepad settings menu 
[i](Input Settings -> Change Settings for Gamepad) [/i]
[i]If the minimum is equal or larger than the maximum, then the reticle will no longer dynamically react to collisions.[/i]
[*] Added a reticle clamp shape option ("Oval" or "Circle") to the gamepad settings menu
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] When finishing a run, the end match summary will now be shown after a short delay
[*] Assorted minor gameplay balance changes
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed track bar UI elements not moving when holding the left or right direction button down
[*] Fixed navigation towards track bar UI elements sometimes not working when using a gamepad
[*] Fixed drop-down list panels hiding the mouse cursor when hovering above them while ingame
[/list]

You can also check out our list of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2621270/discussions/0/4036977429243711876/]known issues[/url].

notes.title: Nextfest Demo Available Now
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone,[/h1]

The Steam Nextfest is coming up and thus we have prepared a brand new demo version of Dusky Depths for you to play! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717128/98875b507f0424457f426d87146284eb23390fbb.png[/img]

You can download the demo on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2621270/Dusky_Depths/]our Steam page[/url].

We've made a lot of changes, both minor and major, since the playtest in december. If you have participated in the playtest, you will find many bugfixes, performance improvements, quality of life improvements, UI refinements and more.

Here's a short list of the highlights:
[list]
[*] The Map screen is now available
[*] The UI scaling can now be adjusted
[*] By default, the HUD is now a bit less cluttered
[*] Additional HUD customization options have been added
[*] Several UI icons have been changed for more clarity
[*] The design of several friendly objects in the world has been revamped
[*] Color correction has been implemented, giving the game a more interesting look
[*] Framerate stuttering has been significantly reduced
[*] ... and many more changes!
[/list]
Additionally, we have prepared a brand new trailer for the Nextfest. Check it out!
[previewyoutube=5F15HqojbtE;full][/previewyoutube]

As Dusky Depths is still in development, we are still open to any kind of feedback from the players. Join our Discord or just comment under this article, we will definitely read it!

👉 [url=https://discord.com/invite/SsbjpHZ][b]Discord[/b][/url]

👉 [url=https://twitter.com/duskydepths][b]Twitter[/b][/url] [i](We're posting some exclusives there from time to time!)[/i]

[b]EDIT:[/b]
We forgot to tell you about the contents of the demo! This demo contains only a fraction of the content of the full game. It's limited to:
[list]
[*] Singleplayer Expedition only
[*] 2 predetermined map randomization seeds
[*] 2 sectors explorable per run
[*] 3 ship loadout presets
[*] A limited amount of items
[/list]

notes.title: What's next for Dusky Depths?
notes.content:
[h1]Hey folks,[/h1]

The Playtest has officially ended today! We thank everyone for participating in our Playtest. We have received a lot of really valuable feedback from you all, and we will definitely use it to further improve Dusky Depths.

[h2]Your Feedback[/h2]
Based on the feedback we have received so far, the most important issues you have raised are:

[h3]The in-game user interface is cluttered[/h3]

The in-game UI shows a lot of information at once, which can be overwhelming. To remedy this issue, we will introduce several configuration options with which the player can customize their UI. By default, we will try to minimize the amount of UI elements shown to the player.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717128/e85ae1dc5b5927dd9672c690605433b1f95af66c.png[/img]
[i]The current HUD. You'll be able to customize many parts of it soon![/i]

[h3]Which objects in the world are interactable?[/h3]
Right now, it's not 100% clear which objects can be interacted with by the player by sight alone. We will try to make it more clear by introducing a consistent design element to all interactables. That way, it should be clear at first glance whether something is interactable or not.

[h3]The functionality of some objects is not clear based on visuals alone[/h3]
Some objects have a somewhat arbitrary design, to the point where it is not clear what they are supposed to be unless you are close enough to them so that a tooltip appears. Those objects will receive new designs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717128/36c8eebbddfae6b80f8ee2b469fafa2b3b86b0e9.png[/img]
[i]Can you guess what this is? Correct, an object that will be redesigned![/i]

[h3]We're still open for feedback![/h3]
If you haven't sent us your feedback yet, but still wish to do so, then you are more than welcome to contact us! Join us on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/SsbjpHZ]Discord server[/url], comment on this article or send us a DM on our [url=https://twitter.com/duskydepths]social media[/url]! We're always open for any kind of feedback.

[h2]What's next?[/h2]

We are currently preparing a Demo for the upcoming [b]Steam Nextfest in February[/b]! Press the Follow button on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2621270/Dusky_Depths/]Steam store page[/url] or follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/duskydepths]Twitter [/url]if you want to get notified when it's ready! We will also announce it on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/SsbjpHZ]Discord server[/url], of course!

In addition to that, we will also be holding another Playtest, but this time to test the [b]multiplayer mode[/b]! We will have more to announce about it in the next few months!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/SsbjpHZ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717128/44473072b9f52800ff0f8b7d5a6e22497fa300de.png[/img][/url]

Otherwise, if you have any questions, please refer to our previous announcement: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2621270/announcements/detail/3896239307767449653]Dusky Depths Playtest Announcement[/url]

[b]We wish you good luck on your exploration of the Dusky Depths![/b]

notes.title: Dusky Depths Playtest Announcement
notes.content:
[b]After many, many years, we are thrilled to finally announce that the Dusky Depths Public Playtest will be starting soon![/b]

Visit our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2621270/Dusky_Depths/]Steam page[/url] and click the [b]Request Access[/b] button to [strike]pre-register and gain access once it starts[/strike] gain access immediately!

[previewyoutube=rhQK8l6Wj_c;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]About the game[/h2]

Dusky Depths is a rogue-lite twin stick shooter set on a mysterious and treacherous planet. Take control of your ship and defend yourself against an onslaught of ancient drones and bizarre organisms. How long can you hold out?

Your only hope of escaping your eventual demise is to restore and activate the warp gates left behind by an ancient civilization. Where will they lead you? There is only one way to find out..

Scavange for rare loot, upgrade your ship, and unlock ancient mechanisms to escape this strange and hostile place – alone or together with friends.

For more information, visit our [url=https://duskydepths.com/game-information.html]website[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717128/5bae02d87bd9aa0a85eaf9f3c5ba697b90b55142.png[/img]


[h2]Playtest FAQ[/h2]

[h3]What is the Dusky Depths Public Playtest?[/h3]
It is a time-limited event during which we will provide an early version of the game for free! The purpose of this Playtest is to uncover potential performance/compatibility/stability issues as well as to gather feedback from players regarding the gameplay. 

[h3]Who can participate?[/h3]
Anyone!

[h3]When will it start/end?[/h3]
Start: [b]December 8th, 4:00pm UTC [/b](17:00 CET / 8:00am PST / Dec 9th 1:00 JST)
End: [b]December 15th, 4:00pm UTC [/b](17:00 CET / 8:00am PST / Dec 12th 1:00 JST)
* Schedule subject to change.

[h3]How will this version of the game differ from the final game?[/h3]
This version of the game will be provided for testing purposes, which is why we have limited its contents:
[list]
[*] Singleplayer Expedition only
[*] Map generation limited to 2 predetermined randomization seeds
[*] 2 sectors explorable per run
[*] 3 ship loadout presets
[*] Limited amount of items, exact amount is subject to change
[/list]
[h3]Will progress be carried over to the full game?[/h3]
No progress will be carried over.

[h3]How do I participate?[/h3]
Visit our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2621270/Dusky_Depths/][b]Steam store page[/b][/url] and click on the big green [b]Request Access[/b]  button! Once the Playtest starts, you will automatically gain access to the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717128/5a2144f48cc974a11a27b466ca9f0dc88aae4f17.png[/img]

[h3]I have more questions, how can I contact you?[/h3]
You can join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/SsbjpHZ]Discord server[/url], message us on [url=https://twitter.com/duskydepths]Twitter[/url] or just comment here!
